احتفروا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَرُوا (iḥtafarū) /iħ.ta.fa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اُحْتُفِرُوا (uḥtufirū) /uħ.tu.fi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اِحْتَفِرُوا (iḥtafirū) /iħ.ta.fi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
